units.source_text: 倘若至始至终坚持理性，我们就必然得否定自己的存在。

en.t: If we adhere to reason from beginning to end, we must inevitably deny our own existence.

units.source_text: 奉理性为神明的伏尔泰能够幸福地度过一生，正表明人类没有河童那样开化。

en.t: That Voltaire, who revered reason as a god, was able to live a happy life proves precisely that human beings are not as enlightened as the kappa.
